basis: First actual original PNG observation, before context, old specs, or authored geometry exposure.

subfigures.description: One upright, central-thicker lens section, with two curved boundaries meeting at upper and lower tips; several diagonal interior material hatch marks.

points.description: Marked point on horizontal axis to the left of the lens.
Marked point on horizontal axis to the right of the lens.
Small interior axis mark with O above it; separate from the hatch marks.
Left curved-boundary intersection with the axis, A below-left.
Right curved-boundary intersection with the axis, B above-right.

relationships.description: One nearly horizontal continuous axis passes through O1, A, O, B, O2 in that left-to-right order and extends beyond the outer points.
Straight segment from O1 to an upper point of the right curved boundary, rising rightward; R1 label above the left-middle part; an arrow-like heavy mark near the boundary.
Straight segment from O2 to a lower point of the left curved boundary, descending leftward; R2 label near the middle; an arrow-like heavy mark near the lower-left boundary.
Two curved boundary strokes form a closed lens, thickest near the axis; both upper and lower ends join.
O lies between A and B, inside the outlined lens.

fineDetailHolds: Interior hatch strokes are visible; individual stroke count is not reliably separable at the original scan resolution.
